children: The confluence of factors driving bond yields sharply higher since late August are showing few, if any, signs of abating, ANZ says in a note to clients. The AI investment cycle remains strong and geopolitical risks remain elevated. Traditional investor appetite for sovereign debt is subdued, and in some instances falling, and central banks are on a tightening path. So, bond prices are naturally resetting, ANZ says. The era of cheap money is over and the dislocation in geopolitics and preponderance of negative supply-side shocks suggests that will remain the case for the foreseeable future, ANZ says. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
